description: Worker executor routing. Rules are evaluated in file order; the first match wins. Card/event metadata.executor is ignored. bin/route is the only reader. `to` is the profile fallback when `when.profiles` is absent; explicit empty allowlists match nothing. Every `skills` entry must resolve under the target profile's `skills/` directory.

rules.name: coder-claude-code
rules.tell: 编码/重构/测试默认 claude_code；claude 不可用（exit 4）时按 executor-contract 回滚 dsh，失败如实写进 review，不伪装成功。

rules.name: researcher-hermes
rules.tell: 调研默认在 worker 进程内用 hermes，不起外部 CLI；hermes 的 exit 4 不是可回滚信号。

rules.name: housekeeper-hermes
rules.tell: 杂务/整理默认在 worker 进程内用 hermes，不起外部 CLI；hermes 的 exit 4 不是可回滚信号。

rules.name: skeptic-hermes
rules.tell: 交叉复核默认在 worker 进程内用 hermes，不起外部 CLI；hermes 的 exit 4 不是可回滚信号。
